build.scope: Movement session opened before the final fresh reload. A later fresh production reload reported index-D1dz4dOS.js and no development global; final-load performance must be rerun against the eventual locked artifact.

method: Desktop Chromium 1366x600. A user-owned normal-play save was imported through System > Save/Replay > Import Save. Visible canvas clicks, normal right-click ground commands, and the visible Stop control were used. No game private API, runtime command, state mutation, route mock, or clock control was used.

archiveImport.finding: Imported units and structures appeared at their archived map positions without an observed spawn-origin leap.

worker.visualFinding: The selected worker visibly moved, stopped through the normal Stop control, then accepted a new direction. The second target approached an owned structure, so the final representative frame shows the resulting normal structure interaction rather than a clean isolated endpoint.

military.visualFinding: The 31-second physical video shows smooth visible travel, a stationary stop interval, and a turn toward the second target without the repeated 100 ms snap-back pattern seen in the old implementation.

lazyPresentation.evidence: Read-only PerformanceResourceTiming from the normal player session.
lazyPresentation.finding: Warrior sheets were requested when imported warriors became present, and miremaw was requested later during play rather than in the initial battle-blocking window. Existing presentation continued while those requests completed.

coordinateExtractionNote: Raw sequential PNGs and WebM videos are authoritative. Experimental copper-ring extraction remains private because similarly colored buildings and UI can attract a tracker after a unit crosses dense scenery.
